nodes.description: ZethrMultiSigWallet.transactions mapping of transactionId to Transaction struct (destination, value, data, executed)
ZethrMultiSigWallet.confirmations mapping tracking which owners confirmed which transaction
ZethrMultiSigWallet.isOwner mapping used by ownerExists/isAnOwner authorization checks
ZethrMultiSigWallet.owners dynamic array of owner addresses
ZethrMultiSigWallet.required number of confirmations needed to execute a transaction
ZethrMultiSigWallet.transactionCount counter of submitted transactions
ZethrMultiSigWallet.reEntered reentrancy guard flag that is declared but never read or written
ZethrGame.pendingBetsQueue array of addresses with unresolved bets
ZethrGame.queueTail index of the next open slot in the pending bets queue
ZethrGame.bets mapping of player address to their BetBase/Bet storage struct
ZethrGame.pendingBetsMapping mapping of player address to their position in the pending bets queue
ZethrGame.controller reference to ZethrBankrollControllerInterface used for authorization and payouts
ZethrGame.paused flag gating bet placement through isNotPaused
ZethrGame.resolverPercentage fraction (x/1,000,000) paid to a resolver of expired bets
ZethrDice.minBet minimum allowed wager size (1e18)
ZethrDice.houseEdge constant (990) applied in profit calculation

ZethrMultiSigWallet.replaceOwner swaps an existing owner for a new one
ZethrMultiSigWallet.changeRequirement updates the required confirmation count
ZethrMultiSigWallet.isConfirmed counts confirmations against owners and required threshold
ZethrMultiSigWallet payable fallback that accepts ETH deposits into the wallet
ZethrGame.resolveExpiredBets walks the pending queue resolving stale bets and pays the resolver through the controller
ZethrGame.finishBet resolves the caller msg.sender bet through finishBetFrom
ZethrGame.ownerSetControllerAddress owner-only setter that replaces the controller used for authorization
ZethrGame.ownerPauseGame owner-only function setting paused to true
ZethrGame.ownerSetResolverPercentage owner-only setter of resolverPercentage
ZethrGame.random reduces maxRandom output modulo _upper for game randomness

ZethrDice.execute places a bet, guarded by isNotPaused, bankrollOnly, betIsValid and hasNotBetThisBlock
ZethrDice.isBetValid validates bet size, roll range and max profit
ZethrDice.getRollOutput computes win/loss amounts across multiple rolls using random()
ZethrDice.calculateProfit computes potential profit with unchecked multiplications on bet size and roll

ZethrDice.getLastRollOutput web3 view helper replaying the players last roll results

edges.reason: executeTransaction performs a low-level call.value() to an attacker-influenced destination
A malicious destination can re-enter executeTransaction because the executed flag is rolled back on failure and no guard is used
Re-entrant call can re-enter confirmTransaction to force additional transaction execution
Re-entrant call can mutate the confirmations mapping while the outer transaction is in flight
reEntered guard state variable is declared but never used to protect executeTransaction
finishBetFrom makes an external call into the bankroll contract before clearing queue and mapping state
The bankroll callback can re-enter finishBetFrom or other game logic
Re-entrant call can manipulate pendingBetsMapping before it is zeroed by the outer finishBetFrom
resolveExpiredBets makes an external call to the controller to pay the resolver
The controller payout callback can re-enter resolveExpiredBets and re-walk the queue
Only addresses recognized as owners via msg.sender checks can trigger executeTransaction paths
addOwner is restricted by the onlyWallet modifier that compares msg.sender to the wallet address
ownerSetControllerAddress is guarded by ownerOnly which validates msg.sender against the controller/multisig
The owner-only setter replaces the controller address that all authorization logic trusts
The resolver msg.sender is the beneficiary of tokensEarned computed in resolveExpiredBets
execute is gated by bankrollOnly which validates msg.sender through controller.isTokenBankroll
ownerSetResolverPercentage is guarded by ownerOnly which validates msg.sender
The owner-controlled setter directly influences resolverPercentage used for resolver payouts
calculateProfit reaches the unchecked multiplication of bet size by the roll payout factor
The overflowable arithmetic result flows back into the profit returned to callers
execute indirectly reaches calculateProfit through bet validation with attacker-supplied values
addTransaction writes a new Transaction struct into the transactions mapping
addTransaction increments transactionCount after storing the transaction
submitTransaction calls addTransaction to create the transaction entry
submitTransaction immediately calls confirmTransaction on the new transaction
confirmTransaction writes the callers confirmation into the confirmations mapping
confirmTransaction calls executeTransaction once a confirmation is recorded
executeTransaction sets and potentially resets the executed flag on the transactions mapping
executeTransaction calls isConfirmed to check the confirmation threshold
isConfirmed reads the confirmations mapping for each owner
isConfirmed iterates over the owners array to count confirmations
executeTransaction reads the owners array indirectly through isConfirmed
addOwner sets the isOwner mapping entry for the new owner
addOwner pushes the new owner onto the owners array
removeOwner mutates the owners array by shifting and shrinking it
removeOwner clears the isOwner flag for the removed address
removeOwner calls changeRequirement when required would exceed the remaining owners
changeRequirement writes the new required confirmation count
The required threshold is consumed by isConfirmed to decide execution eligibility
getLastRollOutput calls getBet to load the players stored bet
getLastRollOutput calls getRollOutput to replay the roll results
getBet reads the bets mapping storage slot for the player
finishBetFrom calls getBet to obtain the players bet pointer
finishBetFrom obtains roll results through the getRollResults to getRollOutput path
finishBetFrom resolves the bankroll tier address through the controller reference
finishBetFrom zeroes the players entry in the pending bets queue
finishBetFrom deletes the players pendingBetsMapping entry
getRollOutput calls random for each roll to derive the dice result
random delegates to maxRandom to produce the raw random number
execute writes the new bet fields into the bets mapping storage struct
execute appends the player to the pendingBetsQueue array
execute increments queueTail after inserting the player
execute stores the players queue position in pendingBetsMapping
execute resolves any pre-existing bet by calling finishBetFrom
execute validates the bet through the betIsValid modifier calling isBetValid
isBetValid enforces the minBet minimum against the supplied token count
isBetValid calls calculateProfit to bound the potential profit
resolveExpiredBets calls finishBetFrom for each expired bet in the queue
resolveExpiredBets reads and clears entries in the pendingBetsQueue array
resolveExpiredBets reads bets blockNumber to test expiry against the current block
resolveExpiredBets uses resolverPercentage to compute tokensEarned for the resolver
finishBet calls finishBetFrom with the caller msg.sender as the player
The paused flag gates bet placement through the isNotPaused modifier on execute
ownerPauseGame flips the paused state that controls whether bets can be placed
ownerPauseGame is guarded by ownerOnly which validates msg.sender against the controller/multisig

normalization_plan.reason: The transactionId parameter is only meaningful as the selector into the transactions mapping consumed by executeTransaction
The owner parameter is used solely to update isOwner/owners state inside addOwner
The destination parameter is stored into the Transaction struct created by addTransaction
The _playerAddress parameter indexes the bets mapping and pendingBetsMapping inside finishBetFrom
The _data payload is decoded into rolls and rollUnder only within execute
local_txToExecute is a storage pointer used only inside executeTransaction to flag and call out
local_playerBetInStorage is a storage pointer used only inside finishBetFrom to reset the bet
local_winAmount accumulates the players winnings only during finishBetFrom settlement
local_lossAmount accumulates the players losses only during finishBetFrom settlement
local_index holds the queue position used only inside finishBetFrom to clear the pending queue
